name: @playform/hook-dsh-normalize-spaces
description: The spaces hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that hooks the llm/stream waterfall — the interceptable wrapper around EVERY streaming model call — and normalizes the unicode space family (U+00A0 no-break space, U+1680 ogham space mark, U+2000–U+200A the en/em/figure/punctuation/thin/hair space run, U+202F narrow no-break space, U+205F medium mathematical space, U+3000 ideographic space) in model output streams, the family's spaces flavor — the CLASS flavor: the core's Spaces class (Unicode's Zs category minus the ASCII space) replaced by the configurable replacement string (default " " — the plain ASCII space), applied to text/reasoning deltas and assembled block-end blocks while tool-call deltas pass through untouched.
